appimage.title: Universal Linux AppImage
appimage.note: Manual option. Recommended: use the Linux quick-install command above to select and verify the package for your distro.

pacman.title: Arch Linux
pacman.note: The installer uses a native pacman package when published; otherwise it installs the verified AppImage.

aur.title: Arch Linux / Manjaro / EndeavourOS
aur.note: PKGBUILD is built and verified working end-to-end, but AUR account registration is temporarily closed — not yet pushed to the actual AUR. Use the pacman package above in the meantime.

exe.title: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit Installer
exe.note: Unsigned release: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run.

dmg.title: macOS Apple Silicon Disk Image
dmg.note: Unsigned release: macOS may require right-click → Open on first launch.

x64Dmg.title: macOS Intel Disk Image
x64Dmg.note: Unsigned release: macOS may require right-click → Open on first launch.
